title: Keto Khus Scones
description: A low-carb twist on traditional scones, infused with the unique flavor of khus grass. Perfect for a keto breakfast or snack.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine almond flour, khus grass powder, and granulated sweetener.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, melted butter, heavy cream, salt, and baking soda.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 2-3 minutes.
Pat the dough into a circle that is about 1 inch (2.5 cm) thick.
Cut the dough into 8-10 triangles or use a biscuit cutter to cut out scones.
Place the scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Remove the scones from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes before serving.
